# FuncHole

> FuncHole turns what you need (a booking system, customer portal, dashboard, API) into a live web solution. Your coding agent writes the solution; FuncHole deploys it, connects it, exposes it at a web address and keeps the backend running. It is a self-hostable platform for coding agents, driven through MCP (Model Context Protocol).

FuncHole is not an AI app builder. The coding agent creates the code; FuncHole runs and operates the backend side: deploying functions, routing HTTP requests through a gateway, custom domains and HTTPS certificates, databases, environment variables and secrets, logs and test invocations. FuncHole is under active development and licensed under FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://funchole.dev/): what FuncHole is and what you can build
- [Start building](https://app.funchole.dev): sign up and create an API key
- [Supported coding agents](https://funchole.dev/#agents): Claude Code, Codex, opencode, Cursor, Antigravity, Puku, and any client that supports MCP over HTTP
- [Pricing](https://funchole.dev/#pricing): FuncHole Cloud early access is free; self-hosting is free
